728-6277-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2033-3249-6887--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2033-3249-6887--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Skullspore Nexus triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1479-2374-2841-8104.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Misty Rainforest.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2374-2841-8104.description:
Fetch a land using Misty Rainforest.
When the fetched land enters, Maja and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Maja trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Maja from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1077-5571-8095--6.description:
Use Wrong Turn to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 2.

6495-6566--5--195.easyPrerequisites: At least one persist creature has any type of counter on it.
6495-6566--5--195.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Yuna trigger.
Resolve Yuna's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Repeat.
6495-6566--5--195.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

618-3817-5256.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller with haste.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life
Repeat.

45-1978-3099-5793.description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding two mana.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Khalni Gem which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

1116-5231-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
1116-5231-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Sek'Kuar and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

141-5231-7166.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5231-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-5231-7166.notes: Perform this combo during your main phase to prevent Dose of Dawnglow from causing you to blight.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

116-4927-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kiora's Follower.
Activate one of the Kiora's Follower tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kiora's Follower token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1395-3835-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat

874-4195-4316-4574.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-4195-4316-4574.description:
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Delif's Cone from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Delif's Cone from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

147-2921-6928.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2921-6928.description:
Cast Prison Break either from your hand by paying {4}{B} or from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {3}{B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Prison Break.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Prison Break, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Prison Break copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2921-6928.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if Prison Break is in your graveyard.

3490-4050-6772.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {1}.
Syr Vondam triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2034-4215-6730.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, moving any counters from it onto another creature you control, and then shuffling Sin into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Sin and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
2034-4215-6730.notes: In order to get infinite +1/+1 counters, remove as many counters as possible when Sin enters, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin as it enters. Those counters can then be moved to another creature when Sin dies.

1358-2034-2054-2073--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the mana value 1 artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Sydri's first ability by paying {U}, causing the artifact to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the artifact, adding {C}{C}.
When the artifact dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Urn of Godfire by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Repeat.

997-2730-6553.easyPrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
997-2730-6553.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2034-4790-5004-5149.notablePrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Dino DNA.
2034-4790-5004-5149.description:
Activate Dino DNA's second ability by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Cathodion that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Cathodion token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Cathodion token dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1109-1123-1636-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Skeleton Ship does not have summoning sickness.
Flayer of the Hatebound does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1109-1123-1636-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound, adding one mana of any color.
Flayer of the Hatebound dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Flayer of the Hatebound enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Flayer of the Hatebound trigger, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Skeleton Ship by tapping it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Flayer of the Hatebound.
Repeat.

259-2104-2963.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Halo-Charged Skaab.
When Halo-Charged Skaab enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each player to mill two cards and put Temporal Manipulation on top of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next durn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.

1446-2034-2060-2466-4680.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1446-2034-2060-2466-4680.description:
Activate Viral Drake by paying {3}{U}, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping The Hollow Sentinel, untapping it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing The Hollow Sentinel, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

914-1170-2815-5078.notablePrerequisites:
You control a Treasure token.
Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1170-2815-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Professional Face-Breaker by sacrificing a Treasure, exiling the top card of your library and allowing you to cast it this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Dockside Extortionist.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing those, adding {2}.
Repeat.

1369-1752-3990.notablePrerequisites:
Quicksilver Elemental has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Quicksilver Elemental does not have summoning sickness.
1369-1752-3990.description:
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, targeting Incubation Druid.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Incubation Druid's second ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, targeting Locust Swarm.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Locust Swarm's second ability by paying {G}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

4046-4944.description:
Activate Outrider en-Kor's ability.
Crackdown Construct gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
